meta.title: UI Without a Round Trip
meta.subtitle: There is no per-frame sync pass. A comparison inside a generated setter decides whether the managed world hears about the write at all

views.label: The write itself
views.note: A system assigns a field on a plain unmanaged struct. That is the entire author-facing API.

views.label: The comparison is the mechanism
views.note: Equal values stop here. No allocation, no call, no boundary crossing — the common case costs a compare.

views.label: How it finds the object
views.note: The struct is pinned, so its address is stable, and the address is the key into a table of view models.

views.label: And then the element
views.note: From here it is ordinary UI Toolkit binding. Nothing about the element knows an entity exists.

cards.title: What is actually per frame
items: Nothing scans anything. There is no diff pass and no flush queue
An unchanged write costs one compare · Anchor BovineLabs.Anchor/Binding/BindingObjectNotifyDataExtensions.cs:34
It returns immediately when the values match · same file:36
So an idle screen with fifty bound fields does fifty compares and stops

cards.title: The setter you never wrote
items: One attribute on a private field · Anchor BovineLabs.Anchor/Contracts/SystemPropertyAttribute.cs:13
A generator emits the property around it · Anchor SourceGenerator~/SystemPropertyGenerator.cs:19
Its setter is hard-wired to the compare-and-notify call · same file:177
Which is why there is no way to write the field and skip the check

cards.title: Why the object has to be pinned
items: The unmanaged data sits on a small managed box · Anchor BovineLabs.Anchor/App/SystemObservableObject.cs:77
Pinning gives it a stable address · Anchor BovineLabs.Anchor/Binding/IBindingObjectNotify`T.cs:25
That address is the dictionary key back · Anchor BovineLabs.Anchor/Binding/BurstObjectNotify.cs:44
The system's handle is that raw pointer · Anchor BovineLabs.Anchor/Utility/UIHelper.cs:23 and :59

cards.title: Where the managed half starts
items: The view model raises the ordinary notifications · Anchor BovineLabs.Anchor/MVVM/ObservableObject.cs:17
Its ECS-facing base owns the unmanaged value · Anchor BovineLabs.Anchor/App/SystemObservableObject.cs:25
From there UI Toolkit binding takes over, and knows nothing about entities
The systems live in a presentation group of their own · Anchor BovineLabs.Anchor/UISystemGroup.cs:15
